text:
People Ops: Policy update live now  Bereavement leave + expedited travel support published: https://redwood.internal/policies/bereavement (TL;DR below)

olivia_manager: TL;DR?

People Ops: TL;DR  employees receive up to 10 paid bereavement days for immediate family loss (up from 5), 2 additional days discretionary for close relatives, and Redwood will reimburse up to $1,000 in emergency travel or change fees per incident. Submit claims within 30 days. Manager notification required ASAP. :pray:

sam_engineering: Is the $1,000 per-person or per-incident?

People Ops: Per incident. If multiple travelers are booked for the same event, include separate receipts in the same claim and itemize passengers.

legal_team: Quick legal note  international tax/treatment may vary. We flag region-specific guidance on the policy page; consult People Ops + Legal for cross-border questions.

payroll_bot: Filing tip: use GL code BRV-PAID for leave and BRV-TRV for travel claims. Reimbursements may be taxable in some regions; payroll will indicate tax treatment in the claim confirmation.

olivia_manager: Can managers pre-approve extra discretionary days?

People Ops: Managers can approve up to 2 discretionary days; any additional paid time routes to People Ops. We ask managers to include a short coverage plan when approving.

sam_engineering: Do contractors get bereavement?

People Ops: Contractors do not receive paid bereavement days but may submit travel reimbursement requests if travel was booked on behalf of Redwood and approved by the hiring manager.

People Ops: Retroactive coverage  we will accept claims for events back to 2025-09-01. Attach travel receipts and a brief note. We will prioritize rapid review for urgent cases.

ops_bot: Published: https://redwood.internal/policies/bereavement  Form: https://redwood.internal/forms/bereavement-claim. Manager one-pager attached to policy.

People Ops: We'll host a 20-min manager Q&A on Friday 10am PT to walk through examples and documentation. DM People Ops for confidential cases; mark subject "CONFIDENTIAL BEREAVEMENT" and we'll triage privately. :white_heart:
